name: Northside Barbers
tagline: Proper cuts, no fuss. Walk in or book ahead.
description: Friendly neighbourhood barbers in Headingley. Skin fades, classic cuts, beard trims and hot towel shaves, with kids and seniors welcome.

services.title: Services & prices
services.intro: Straightforward prices, no surprises. Every cut finishes with a hot towel and a styling product of your choice.

items.name: Skin fade
items.description: Taken down to the skin, blended by hand.

items.name: Restyle
items.description: Long to short, or a whole new look.

items.name: Beard trim & shape
items.description: Shaped with clippers, lined with a razor.

items.name: Hot towel shave
items.description: Pre-shave oil, two hot towels, straight razor.

items.name: Cut & beard
items.description: Any cut plus a full beard trim.

categories.name: Kids & seniors
categories.description: Kids under 12. Seniors 65+, Monday to Thursday.

services.note: Card and cash welcome. Very long or thick hair may cost a little more; we'll always tell you before we start.

walkIns.title: Walk-ins welcome
walkIns.description: No appointment needed. Grab a seat and we'll get you in the chair. Prefer a set time? Book ahead.

seo.title: Northside Barbers · Headingley, Leeds
seo.description: Walk-in and bookable barbers in Headingley. Fades, classic cuts, beard trims and hot towel shaves. Open seven days.

contact.title: Get in touch
contact.intro: Questions about cuts, group bookings or the shop? Drop us a line and one of the team will get back to you.

success.title: Message sent
success.description: Cheers, it's with the team. We'll reply within a working day.

newsletter.title: Stay in the chair
newsletter.intro: Quiet-slot alerts, new barbers and the odd offer. One email a month, tops.

success.title: You're on the list
success.description: We'll let you know when there's something worth hearing.

failed.title: That didn't go through
failed.description: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment. Your details are still here.

contact.subject: Thanks for getting in touch

contact.heading: Cheers, we've got it
contact.body: Thanks for your message. One of the barbers will get back to you within a working day. If it's about a cut today, walk-ins are always welcome.

newsletter.preview: Quiet-slot alerts and the odd offer, once a month at most.
newsletter.heading: You're on the list
newsletter.body: Thanks for signing up. Expect quiet-slot alerts, new faces in the shop and the odd offer, never more than once a month.
